articles.title: Will mortgage rates ever drop to 3% again?
articles.summary: Mortgage rates were in the 3% range in 2020 and 2021. Rates are higher now, but will they fall to 3% again? Learn whether you should wait for lower rates.
articles.body:

It would take a drastic series of circumstances, aggressive rate buydowns, particularly from new home builders — or finding an assumable mortgage. In 2021, the average 30-year mortgage rate fell below 3%. Now, according to Freddie Mac, it's over 7%.

In 2020 and 2021, Americans witnessed record-low mortgage rates. The lowest 30-year fixed rate was 2.65% in January 2021, but rates hovered at or below 3% for a couple of years. However, home loan rates are unlikely to drop back down to 3% anytime soon. To understand why, consider two key factors: the circumstances that initially drove the drastic drop in interest rates and the factors that are currently determining today's higher rates .

Why did rates fall to 3%? It took a pandemic.

Home loan interest rates reached historic lows in 2021 as the Federal Reserve aggressively cut rates to mitigate the economic effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

The pandemic impacted the economy in several ways, including widespread unemployment and supply shortages. To encourage spending and avoid a major recession, the Fed began lowering the federal funds rate in March 2020, making it cheaper to borrow money as Americans faced job losses.

Although many factors influence home loan rates, mortgage rates typically follow the general direction of the federal funds rate. By late December 2020, the average rate for a 30-year mortgage was even lower than 3%, at 2.66%.

Why did mortgage rates increase? Inflation and Fed rate hikes.

Lower interest rates and pandemic-relief stimulus programs increased consumer demand, one of several factors that drove higher inflation .

The Federal Reserve monitors this rate, which measures changes in the prices of goods and services, and aims to keep it around 2% based on yearly changes in the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index.

By 2022, the PCE inflation rate was over 5%, and the Fed began a series of fed funds rate hikes to curb it. The central bank raised its rate 11 times in 2022 and 2023. Mortgage rates followed suit, peaking at 7.79% in October 2023 before hovering around 6.6% at year-end.

Will mortgage rates ever go back down to 3%?

Many experts expect 30-year mortgage rates to remain above 7% in 2027. Here are two reasons why.

Inflation: Higher inflation can push mortgage rates up as the Federal Reserve raises the benchmark interest rate to tame rising consumer prices.

10-year Treasury yield: Mortgage rates tend to follow the direction of the 10-year Treasury yield . Unlike the fed funds rate, the 10-year yield is a greater indicator of rates on longer-term loans — like home loans. Recently, Treasury yields have been at multi-year highs.

While a conventional mortgage at 3% isn't possible today, there are pathways to a well-below-market mortgage rate.

There are assumable government mortgages held by current homeowners with rates near 3%. If they decide to sell, you may be able to take over their loan and the low rate, if the lender approves. These assumable loans are generally backed by the VA, the FHA, or the USDA.

Assuming a mortgage isn't easy. You have to:

Find a seller with an assumable mortgage.

Pay the seller the equity they have in the house (the equity gap ) in cash from your personal savings or by securing a secondary loan.

Be approved by the current lender servicing the loan to assume the balance due.

Another way to achieve a home loan rate below today's prevailing 7% is to use a rate buydown. These discounted mortgage rates are most often offered by new home construction builders through their affiliated lenders.

Usually, the discounts are spread over three years, with the largest discount in year one, a notch higher in year two, and yet another bump up in year three. An example:

The 3-2-1 buydown reduces your rate by three points in the first year, then two, and finally a one-point discount in the third year. With current rates near 7%, that would mean an initial loan rate of 4%, then 5%, and finally 6%. In the fourth year, your mortgage would reset to a permanent fixed rate of 7%.

In addition to new home builders, some retail mortgage lenders may offer a one- or two-year buydown. And home sellers are increasingly offering concessions to buyers to compensate for a growing number of buyer's markets.

You can also buy discount points, essentially prepaid interest, to buy down your interest rate with a lender. Typically, $1000 gets you a 0.25% rate break.

How to get the best mortgage rate today (in real life)

In today's world, without snagging an assumable loan or a drastic buydown, you won't get a 3% home loan. But you can't keep your homebuying plans on hold forever. You can take steps to secure the lowest mortgage rate possible .

Boost your credit score: A higher credit score makes you more likely to get a lower interest rate. Improve your score by paying your credit cards and other debts on time and resolving errors on your report.

Pay down debt: Reducing your debt lowers your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, a factor mortgage lenders consider when determining your loan eligibility and the rate you qualify for.

Compare multiple lenders: Get preapproval from more than one mortgage lender to compare interest rates, repayment terms, and discounts.

Negotiate fees: Pay attention to closing costs and ask your loan advisor if there's an opportunity to waive or reduce some fees.

Will mortgage rates ever be 3% again? FAQs

It's unlikely you'll see a 3% mortgage rate anytime soon. According to Freddie Mac, the average interest rate on a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage is well over 7%. Mortgage rates hit historic lows in 2021 due to the Federal Reserve's response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Most experts say mortgage rates will stay in the upper 6% to mid-7% range in 2027.

Timing the housing market can be challenging, and deciding when to lock in a mortgage rate is just as difficult. Generally, you should buy a house when you find the right one, and it makes financial sense — you have enough saved for the down payment and can afford the monthly mortgage. Refinance when you can lower your interest rate or land better loan terms, like moving from an adjustable-rate to a fixed-rate mortgage.

articles.title: How Nvidia's stock decline could impact your 401(k) and portfolio
articles.summary: You don't need to own a single share of Nvidia to feel the impact.
articles.body:
Americans have likely been taking a second glance at their 401(k)s and portfolios as Nvidia ( NVDA ) stock has experienced turbulence over CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

Shares of Nvidia, a company co-founded by Huang in 1993 that has become the backbone of the AI build-out, are down more than 30% over the past month. The stock fell from a record high in early October, when Nvidia had a market cap of roughly $5.8 trillion, losing approximately $2 trillion in market value.

Even if you don't own Nvidia shares, you might still be exposed to the stock.

Retirement plans like 401(k)s, IRAs, or public pension fund s often invest in index funds. When a heavily weighted stock within one of those indexes has a bad day, so can your investments, Mattie Duppler said in her Substack Forward Strategies.

Nvidia has a less-than-6% weighting in the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ), so if an investor's 401(k) holds an S&P 500 index fund or a S&P 500 target-date fund, they will face some exposure.

You might also be exposed to the stock through market cap-weighted ETFs like the QQQ ( QQQ ) or SPY ( SPY ), which similarly track major indexes.

"Nvidia is such a big part of the market, and they're part of that 'Mag Seven' trade, which is overweight in market cap-weighted ETFs like the QQQ or the SPY," Kelly Intelligence CEO Kevin Kelly said at Yahoo Finance Invest .

Still, Kelly noted that investors in those ETFs remain "well diversified."

"If you go into a QQQ, that has Alphabet … Microsoft — it's got other names that are very well diversified," he said. "I mean, think about Amazon. Amazon has their e-commerce platform. They've got their entertainment platform, they've got AWS …. you're still OK."

He also noted that while investors should buckle up for some volatility, they shouldn't worry too much.

"I wouldn't be overly worried. I think right here, you know, this too shall pass," Kelly said. "If you think about Nvidia and where they are … they're a huge company with a deep bench. They're systemically important to AI, especially when it comes to semiconductors. They've done very well over the years. They kind of created this space."

articles.title: Toys 'R' Us opens 160-plus stores, plans new NYC location
articles.summary: Toys "R" Us has opened more than 160 standalone US stores and is preparing to open a new location at New York City's Grand Central Terminal.
articles.body:
Nearly a decade after filing for bankruptcy and closing stores nationwide, Toys "R" Us is back, having opened more than 160 standalone locations across the United States as it continues rebuilding its presence in the country.

The company announced on Nov. 13 that its nationwide expansion, in partnership with Go! Retail Group, is complete , with more than 160 standalone locations now open. The rollout follows an expansion announced in September, when Toys "R" Us said it planned to open 120 new stores ahead of the holiday shopping season.

The retailer is also preparing to open a new location at New York City's Grand Central Terminal. A grand opening celebration is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 20, giving shoppers another place to find toys and holiday gifts ahead of Thanksgiving and Black Friday.

The event will begin at 10 a.m. ET at 89 East 42nd St. and feature an appearance by Geoffrey the Giraffe, the company's mascot. The first 50 customers in line will receive a special giveaway, according to Toys "R" Us.

What will the new Toys 'R' Us store sell?

The Grand Central Terminal location will feature a curated selection of toys, collectibles and gifts from popular brands and entertainment franchises, including Lego, Barbie, Hot Wheels, Pokémon and "KPop Demon Hunters."

The new store will serve commuters, tourists, collectors and other visitors to the Manhattan transportation hub, the company said.

Other standalone Toys "R" Us locations carry toys and collectibles from major brands, with select stores offering additional attractions such as candy shops, cafés and Creator Studios. The latter provides spaces for toy brands and content creators to film videos, unveil products and host events.

Toys "R" Us filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September 2017 while carrying about $5 billion in debt. The retailer liquidated its U.S. business and closed its remaining stores the following year.

The brand began returning to physical retail in 2019, opening smaller stores in New Jersey and Texas. Both locations eventually closed in 2021.

WHP Global acquired Toys "R" Us in 2021 and continued rebuilding the brand. In 2022, the company began opening Toys "R" Us shops inside Macy's stores nationwide. It later partnered with Go! Retail Group to expand its standalone store presence.

Where else can shoppers find Toys 'R' Us?

The retailer's U.S. presence extends beyond its standalone stores. Toys "R" Us has approximately 400 shops inside Macy's locations nationwide.

articles.title: FAA lifts ground stop flights, airline stocks fall
articles.summary: Airline stocks fell right before Friday's close after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop. Departing flights cannot ta...
articles.body:
The FAA lifted a nationwide ground stop Friday evening after aging infrastructure forced the agency to halt outbound flights for hours, leaving passengers stranded at airports across the US.

The Federal Aviation Administration canceled the ground stop at 8:15 p.m. ET Friday, but delays are expected to extend into the weekend, with plans to prioritize aircraft that have more passengers on board.

Airline stocks fell right in post-market trading on Friday after the FAA ordered the nationwide ground stop. Departing flights could not take off, while flights already in the air continued to their destination.

At a press conference following the lift, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said aging infrastructure led to the ground stop.

"Our switches, our routers, actually got overloaded with data, and they went down…and I shouldn't say they went down. They started to give us inconsistency in the data from those routers, and because of that, we shut the system down," he said.

He added that there needs to be a complete overhaul of the system, including investing in new towers and airports, which he estimates will cost about $50 billion.

Shares of American Airlines ( AAL ), Southwest ( LUV ), JetBlue ( JBLU ), Delta Air Lines ( DAL ), and United Airlines ( UAL ) all moved lower on the news. The economic impact of the outage is unknown.

Around 5 p.m. Eastern, the FAA said in a statement on X that there was "a temporary telecommunications outage" and, "out of an abundance of caution," all flights had been halted. At the time, there were roughly 3,500 planes in the air, but more than 10,000 flights were disrupted.

This nationwide grounding was extremely rare. The last time that the FAA halted all US departures was in January of 2023 due to a system outage. Prior to that, traffic was halted after the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks.

Meanwhile, Microsoft said in a statement posted on X that the nationwide FAA ground stop was not related to any of its services. The tech giant apologized earlier on Friday for a software outage that left users unable to access Outlook email and other services, as the company worked to resolve the issues from Thursday into Friday.

articles.title: Uepa abre seleção para residência médica com 34 vagas em Santarém; inscrições vão até 26 de novembro | G1
articles.standfirst: Prazo de inscrição vai até 26 de novembro de 2026. Prova objetiva será aplicada em janeiro de 2027.
articles.summary: Prazo de inscrição vai até 26 de novembro de 2026. Prova objetiva será aplicada em janeiro de 2027.
articles.body:
Uepa abre seleção para residência médica com 34 vagas em Santarém; inscrições vão até 26 de novembro — Foto: Agência Pará/Divulgação

A Universidade do Estado do Pará (Uepa) abriu inscrições para o Processo Seletivo Unificado de Residência Médica (PSU/2027). Ao todo, são oferecidas 246 vagas no estado para médicos formados e estudantes do último semestre do curso de Medicina. Para Santarém, a instituição oferta 34 vagas. Os interessados podem se inscrever até o dia 26 de novembro de 2026.

As oportunidades estão distribuídas em três municípios:

Santarém: 34 vagas em 14 especialidades;

Marabá: 3 vagas em Medicina de Família e Comunidade.

Em Santarém, as vagas contemplam áreas como Anestesiologia, Clínica Médica, Cirurgia Geral, Cirurgia Oncológica, Ortopedia e Traumatologia. Todos os programas são vinculados à rede pública de saúde e credenciados pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

As inscrições devem ser feitas pela internet, na página oficial de seleções do portal da Uepa.

A seleção terá etapa única, com a aplicação de uma prova objetiva de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. O exame está previsto para o dia 17 de janeiro de 2027, nas cidades de Belém e Santarém.

Médicos estrangeiros ou brasileiros formados no exterior devem apresentar o diploma revalidado por uma instituição pública brasileira para participar do processo.

A divulgação do resultado final está prevista para 19 de fevereiro de 2027. Os aprovados começam as atividades da residência em março de 2027.

Os residentes selecionados receberão a Bolsa Nacional de Residência Médica. Além disso, para as vagas elegíveis, haverá o pagamento da Bolsa de Incentivo Estadual Qualifica Saúde, um adicional oferecido pelo Governo do Pará para valorizar o atendimento médico nas unidades do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

A Uepa orienta os candidatos a lerem o edital completo para conferir os requisitos de cada especialidade e a documentação exigida. Dúvidas devem ser enviadas para o e-mail: residenciamedica@uepa.br.

O que: Processo Seletivo de Residência Médica Uepa 2027

Vagas: 246 no Pará (sendo 34 em Santarém)

Inscrições: até 26 de novembro de 2026, pelo site da Uepa

Resultado final: 19 de fevereiro de 2027

articles.title: Como uma vaca pode valer R$ 54 milhões e render fortunas com genética | G1
articles.standfirst: O g1 foi a Uberaba conhecer Donna, a vaca mais cara do mundo, que tem três clones e cinco donos, incluindo o cantor Murilo Huff. Um lote de seus óvulos já foi vendido por R$ 3 milhões. Entenda o negócio milionário por trás dela.
articles.summary: O g1 foi a Uberaba conhecer Donna, a vaca mais cara do mundo, que tem três clones e cinco donos, incluindo o cantor Murilo Huff. Um lote de seus óvulos já foi vendido por R$ 3 mi.
articles.body:
"Por que as pessoas desejam ter uma Mercedes ou uma Ferrari?"

Foi com uma pergunta que o presidente da Associação dos Criadores de Nelore do Brasil (ACNB), Victor Paulo Silva Miranda, respondeu quando questionado sobre o que faz uma vaca valorizar tanto a ponto de atingir um recorde mundial de R$ 54 milhões .

O caso é brasileiro. A vaca Donna FIV CIAV , nascida no Paraná, alcançou esse valor em novembro do ano passado, durante um leilão em Foz do Iguaçu. Atualmente, ela vive em Uberaba (MG), onde divide seu espaço com três clones idênticos produzidos em laboratório. O g1 foi conhecê-las de perto.

"Um animal vira uma 'grife' quando muitos produtores passam a desejar a genética daquela linhagem" , destaca Miranda, da ACNB.

A Donna faz parte do que hoje é conhecido no Brasil como “pecuária de elite”, um setor formado por produtores que estão conseguindo multiplicar ganhos a partir da genética e clonagem de animais considerados excepcionais. Ou, melhor, que têm acesso a cientistas capazes de fazer isso.

Donna FIV CIAV, vaca mais cara do mundo, é avaliada em R$ 54 milhões; ela nasceu no Paraná e vive hoje em Minas Gerais. — Foto: Giaccomo Voccio/g1

O responsável pelo sucesso de Donna é Rodolfo Rumpf, pesquisador e médico-veterinário que comanda hoje a Geneal – Genética e Biotecnologia Animal, em Uberaba. Foi ele quem liderou a primeira clonagem animal do Brasil, da bezerra Vitória, em 2001, pela Embrapa .

A “pecuária de elite” é um universo particular dentro da pecuária. Os animais de elite não conhecem o abate, não vão virar carne no frigorífico nem produzir leite para ser vendido no supermercado.

Em vez disso, eles são negociados em leilões e avaliados em concursos, onde o seu valor é determinado por características muito buscadas por criadores, como alta fertilidade e rapidez no ganho de peso.

"A Donna foi a leilão porque o próprio mercado pediu" , conta Fernando Barros, diretor da Agro Mata Velha, uma das cinco empresas que detêm a propriedade dela.

Donna é filha da vaca Parla FIV AJJ e do touro Big Ben, dois animais que acumularam prêmios ao longo da vida. Ela nasceu em 2015, onze anos depois da morte do seu pai. E isso só foi possível porque o sêmen do Big Ben permaneceu congelado, dando origem não só a Donna, como a outros animais premiados.

"Ela emprenhou muito cedo, pariu sem dificuldades, teve uma boa produção de leite e desmamou bezerros pesados. Quando ela nasceu, já chamou a atenção por ser uma bezerra linda e por ser filha de dois campeões de pista", conta Ricardo Marchetti, gerente da Fazenda Mata Velha, onde a Donna mora hoje.

No vídeo abaixo, veja a rotina da Donna, que conta com hidratação nos chifres, dois banhos ao dia e 'damas de companhia'.

O uso de reprodução assistida, inclusive, é muito comum no universo da pecuária de elite. A Donna, por exemplo, nasceu de uma fertilização in vitro — daí vem o seu segundo sobrenome "FIV". O terceiro, "CIAV", faz referência ao nome do criatório onde ela nasceu.

"A Donna é reflexo de um trabalho de muitos anos de seleção. A gente conhece a avó dela, a mãe dela. É um pouco mais do que vale quanto pesa", comenta Rumpf.

"De um lado, ela consegue produzir muitas filhas valiosas. E, por outro, touros valiosos. Então é muito raro você ter, hoje, uma doadora que consegue atender a essas duas vertentes: produzir filhas produtivas e touros que vão disseminar essa genética mundo afora", ressalta.

Imagem da Donna FIV CIAV pastando. Ela tem cinco donos, entre eles o cantor sertanejo Muril — Foto: Giaccomo Voccio/g1

O diretor da Geneal explica que as pesquisas com clonagem também têm o objetivo de produzir animais que possam melhorar a produção de carne e leite no Brasil, e que os resultados desse trabalho já vêm chegando aos rebanhos comerciais.

"Hoje você pode trazer para a sua propriedade, por exemplo, independente do tamanho, sêmen dos melhores touros do mundo a um custo-benefício compatível", comenta o pesquisador.

"A pecuária de elite é como a Fórmula 1. Toda tecnologia testada e desenvolvida nesses animais de alto valor genético chega, em algum momento, na ponta. É como o controle de tração: foi testado na Fórmula 1 e hoje está presente nos carros", ilustra Marchetti.

Davi Ferreira Silva, funcionário da Fazenda Mata Velha, dá o primeiro banho do dia na Donna. Ela toma dois banhos ao dia e recebe hidratação nos chifres. — Foto: Giaccomo Voccio/g1

Além da Agro Mata Velha, mais quatro empresas dividem a propriedade da Donna, entre elas a Nelore Huff, que pertence ao cantor sertanejo Murilo Huff . Foi a partir de uma parceria dele com outro grupo sertanejo, o Traia Véia, que a Donna atingiu o posto de recordista mundial.

Juntas, a Nelore Huff e a Traia Nelore arremataram 25% da Donna por R$ 13,5 milhões no leilão Cataratas Collection, em novembro de 2025, o que elevou o valor de mercado da vaca para R$ 54 milhões .

As outras sócias são a Casa Branca Agropastoril e a Agropecuária LMC, do pecuarista Lucas Moura, que também era dono de uma casa de apostas esportivas, a GingaBet.

Atualmente, a Donna vive na fazenda da Agro Mata Velha, empresa do grupo Brasif, do empresário Jonas Barcellos Corrêa Filho. Além de investimentos no agronegócio, como no setor sucroenergético, o grupo também controla negócios em outras áreas, entre eles a rede de roupas íntimas Loungerie e o próprio laboratório Geneal, onde são feitas as clonagens e FIVs de bovinos de elite.

Dividir a sociedade de uma vaca não significa que cada empresa vai ficar com uma parte física do animal. O que se compartilha são os direitos de explorar comercialmente a sua genética.

No caso da Donna, os sócios conseguem lucrar, por exemplo, com a venda dos oócitos dela, ou seja, dos óvulos. Um pacote com cerca de 100 deles já foi vendido por R$ 3 milhões, conta Barros, diretor da Agro Mata Velha.

Cada sócio da Donna tem direito a vender seus óvulos, embriões e filhos. — Foto: Bruna Azevedo/g1

Outra fonte de renda é a venda de prenhezes . Nesse caso, embriões produzidos com a genética da Donna são transferidos para outras vacas receptoras, conhecidas como "barrigas de aluguel", que depois são comercializadas já grávidas.

Foi dessa forma, inclusive, que a própria Donna foi negociada pela primeira vez: ainda na barriga da vaca receptora, por R$ 136 mil, conta Heitor Lutti Pinheiro Machado, assessor pecuário da SAP Assessoria.

E o valor dessa genética continua sendo explorado depois do nascimento, já que bezerros e filhos adultos da Donna também são comercializados. "Tem filhas da Donna que são vendidas por 2 milhões, 3 milhões, 4 milhões até 5 milhões", comenta Barros.

À esquerda, Donna FIV CIAV e, à direita, uma de suas clones. — Foto: Giaccomo Voccio/g1

A venda de genética, portanto, maximiza os ganhos de quem detém um animal já muito valioso. E o valor milionário está diretamente ligado ao potencial de multiplicar a genética dele em escala industrial.

"Em vez de ter apenas um bezerro por ano, a Donna passa por uma aspiração folicular a cada 30 dias. Uma única aspiração pode gerar cerca de 100 oócitos, resultando em aproximadamente 12 prenhezes", ilustra Marchetti, gerente da Fazenda Mata Velha.

As clones da Donna também permitem essa maximização . Como elas têm a mesma genética, conseguem produzir os mesmos resultados e multiplicar a quantidade de material disponível para venda.

Histórico de valorização da vaca Donna FIV CIAV. — Foto: Bruna Azevedo/g1

Mas, se uma vaca dá tanto lucro, por que vale a pena dividir a sua sociedade? Barros explica que é como uma empresa: quando o animal atinge o seu auge de valorização, os proprietários consideram vender partes dela.

"A venda de percentuais serve para impulsionar o valor de mercado da vaca. Quando inclui novos sócios, ela ganha mais visibilidade pois tem mais pessoas trabalhando juntas naquela genética específica. Então divulga muito mais, a repercussão é maior", diz Barros.

Davi Ferreira Silva, funcionário da Fazenda Mata Velha, hidratando os chifres da Donna. — Foto: Giaccomo Voccio/g1

A poucos quilômetros da fazenda onde a Donna vive, em Uberaba, fica o laboratório comandado pelo pesquisador Rodolfo Rumpf, que já entregou mais de 700 clones bovinos a pecuaristas brasileiros.

O processo de clonagem é muito complexo e tem uma taxa de eficiência muito baixa. A cada 100 óvulos utilizados nessa técnica, por exemplo, apenas cinco resultam no nascimento de um animal clonado.

Isso porque é muito difícil fazer com que uma célula adulta, já especializada em determinada função, volte a se comportar como uma célula embrionária e seja capaz de reiniciar todo o processo de desenvolvimento.

Para conseguir isso, o processo passa por várias etapas. Tudo começa com a retirada de um pequeno pedaço de pele do animal que se deseja clonar. No laboratório, as células desse tecido são isoladas e cultivadas por cerca de 7 a 15 dias, período em que se multiplicam.

Em paralelo, o laboratório prepara os ovócitos, células reprodutivas femininas ainda em fase de maturação, antes de se tornarem óvulos.

Com a ajuda de microscópios e instrumentos de alta precisão, os cientistas removem o DNA original desses ovócitos, deixando apenas o citoplasma. Assim, eles ficam preparados para receber o DNA do animal que se deseja clonar.

Após isso, uma das células da vaca que será clonada é introduzida em um dos ovócitos, com a ajuda de uma pipeta. Em seguida, um estímulo elétrico faz com que a célula e o citoplasma do ovócito se fundam. Com isso, o ovócito passa a carregar o DNA do animal que está sendo clonado.

Depois da fusão, são aplicados estímulos químicos que simulam a fecundação para dar início ao desenvolvimento embrionário. Se o embrião se desenvolver adequadamente, ele é transferido para o útero de outra vaca, que levará a gestação adiante até o nascimento do clone, cerca de nove meses depois.

articles.title: Um bilhão de refeições no lixo todo dia; como evitar desperdício de alimentos em casa? | G1
articles.standfirst: Especialistas afirmam que reduzir o desperdício de alimentos é uma das ações climáticas mais concretas que podemos adotar individualmente.
articles.summary: Especialistas afirmam que reduzir o desperdício de alimentos é uma das ações climáticas mais concretas que podemos adotar individualmente.
articles.body:
A alimentação em casa responde por 60% do desperdício de aliementos, segundo a ONU. — Foto: REUTERS / Edgar Su

"Nos últimos sete anos, passei a pensar melhor antes de comprar alimentos , levando para casa apenas a quantidade que eu ou as pessoas para quem cozinho vamos consumir", diz a escritora e criadora de conteúdo turca Ceren Özkan.

Desde 2019, ela adota um estilo de vida com desperdício zero, o que significa reduzir ao mínimo tudo o que descarta — e os alimentos têm um papel importante nisso.

" Mudar de casa pode ser desafiador, porque leva tempo até estabelecer uma nova rotina . Doenças ou viagens de férias também podem atrapalhar as coisas, mas a prática se tornou parte natural do meu dia a dia", afirma.

O mundo desperdiça mais de 1 bilhão de toneladas de alimentos por ano , segundo um relatório de 2024 do Programa das Nações Unidas para o Meio Ambiente (Pnuma). Ao mesmo tempo, 645 milhões de pessoas enfrentam a fome.

Pela primeira vez, o desperdício zero, incluindo o de alimentos, estará em evidência na cúpula climática da ONU , a COP31, que acontece neste mês em Antália, na Turquia .

Özkan considera positiva a atenção dada ao tema, mas mantém o ceticismo.

"Adoraria que me provassem que estou errada, mas a conscientização precisa ser acompanhada de ações e responsabilização."

Suas preocupações refletem um desafio mais amplo. Até agora, apenas 30 países incluíram a perda e/ou o desperdício de alimentos em seus planos nacionais de ação climática.

"Esperamos que este momento político em torno da prevenção e da redução do desperdício de alimentos ajude muito mais países a incorporar o tema em suas estratégias climáticas nacionais", afirma Clementine O'Connor, que coordena o trabalho do Pnuma sobre sistemas alimentares urbanos e desperdício de alimentos.

Venda de alimentos no varejo responde por 12% dos desperdício de comida. — Foto: Tânia Rêgo / Agência Brasil

Quanto cada pessoa desperdiça de alimentos?

Segundo a ONU , cada pessoa desperdiça, em média, 79 kg de alimentos por ano em casa. Isso equivale a pelo menos 1 bilhão de refeições desperdiçadas todos os dias no mundo.

No Brasil, a estimativa é de que cada pessoa desperdice 77 kg de alimentos por ano, segundo a mesma instituição. O cálculo tem como base um estudo realizado no Rio de Janeiro.

Conduzida em 2023, a pesquisa acompanhou 102 domicílios na capital fluminense, dos quais 86 participaram ativamente, em todas as regiões do município. O estudo constatou que os resíduos alimentares representaram 62% da massa total de resíduos domiciliares.

As residências são, portanto, a principal fonte do problema, responsáveis por 60% do desperdício . Em seguida vêm os serviços de alimentação, como restaurantes e refeitórios escolares, que respondem por 28% , e o varejo, responsáveis por 12% .

Enquanto o desperdício de alimentos ocorre nas etapas de varejo, restaurantes e residências, a perda de alimentos se refere ao que é descartado nas fases anteriores da cadeia de abastecimento, entre a colheita e a chegada ao mercado.

Restaurantes e refeitórios são responsáveis por 28% do desperdício de alimentos. — Foto: Fernando Frazão / Agência Brasil

"Os Estados Unidos estão entre os países que mais geram desperdício de alimentos", afirma Liz Goodwin, pesquisadora sênior do Instituto de Recursos Mundiais (WRI, na sigla em inglês).

"Alguns países do Oriente Médio também desperdiçam muitos alimentos, o que é igualmente surpreendente, já que importam boa parte do que consomem."

Goodwin, porém, ressalta que é difícil comparar os países com precisão devido à falta de dados confiáveis.

Uma das descobertas mais surpreendentes da pesquisa do Pnuma é como o desperdício de alimentos nas residências se mantém em níveis semelhantes em diferentes países.

"Havia uma narrativa anterior de que o desperdício de alimentos era um problema dos países de alta renda , enquanto a perda de alimentos era uma questão dos países de baixa renda. Mas os dados mostram que não é bem assim", diz O'Connor. "É um problema global."

Jornadas de trabalho longas ou responsabilidades com cuidados familiares: muitos dos fatores que levam ao desperdício de alimentos são surpreendentemente semelhantes no mundo todo, diz ela.

No entanto, em países mais quentes, o acesso limitado à refrigeração e ao armazenamento refrigerado pode fazer com que os alimentos estraguem mais rapidamente.

Desperdício de alimentos prejudica o meio ambiente. — Foto: Fabio Rodrigues-Pozzebom / Agência Brasil

Por que o desperdício de alimentos é tão prejudicial ao planeta?

Segundo a ONU , a perda e o desperdício de alimentos são responsáveis por 8% a 10% das emissões globais de gases de efeito estufa.

Por isso, reduzir pela metade o desperdício global de alimentos até 2030 é uma das metas dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) das Nações Unidas.

Quando os alimentos se decompõem em aterros sanitários na ausência de oxigênio, produzem metano, um potente gás causador do efeito estufa.

Ele é " 84 vezes mais potente que o CO₂ em um período de 20 anos ", afirma O'Connor. Por isso, reduzir o desperdício de alimentos pode ter um "impacto muito rápido" nos esforços para combater as mudanças climáticas.

A produção de alimentos também exige enormes quantidades de terra e água , além de energia e outros recursos. Quando os alimentos são desperdiçados, esses recursos também são desperdiçados, contribuindo para a perda de biodiversidade.

Além disso, reduzir a perda e o desperdício de alimentos pode aumentar a oferta disponível, o que tende a baixar os preços e tornar os alimentos mais acessíveis, afirma O'Connor.

Produção de alimentos demanda insumos e água. — Foto: Fernando Frazão / Agência Brasil

Como reduzir o desperdício de alimentos em casa?

As mudanças climáticas podem, às vezes, parecer um problema impossível de enfrentar , diz O'Connor. Mas essa é uma área em que as pessoas podem fazer uma diferença concreta.

O Project Drawdown , uma organização americana sem fins lucrativos que se dedica a soluções científicas para combater as mudanças climáticas, aponta a redução das perdas e do desperdício de alimentos como a principal ação climática que podemos adotar, ela afirma.

Goodwin diz que pequenas mudanças nos hábitos cotidianos podem ajudar. Fazer uma lista de compras é um bom começo, assim como entender a diferença entre os rótulos "consumir de preferência antes de" e "consumir até".

A expressão "consumir de preferência antes de" está relacionada à qualidade, não à segurança do alimento. Depois dessa data, o produto pode perder um pouco do sabor ou da textura, mas, em geral, continua próprio para consumo.

"Muitas pessoas simplesmente jogam fora produtos que passaram da data de validade indicada como 'consumir de preferência antes de'. É uma pena", afirma Goodwin.

Defensores da sustentabilidade de diferentes partes do mundo compartilham suas próprias dicas para reduzir o desperdício de alimentos em casa.

Charlotte Brum Bezié, influenciadora adepta do desperdício zero na Cidade do México , recomenda usar a inteligência artificial para calcular exatamente a quantidade de alimentos necessária para cada refeição ao longo da semana.

Para ter uma noção real do desperdício, ela sugere marcar na nota fiscal tudo o que foi consumido e depois calcular quanto dinheiro foi gasto com alimentos que acabaram no lixo. Pode ser "de cortar o coração", diz ela, mas o método sempre funciona.

Rahaf Allymoni, criadora de uma alternativa ao café feita de sementes de tâmara, sugere reservar uma prateleira da geladeira para os alimentos mais antigos e consumi-los antes de comprar novos.

"Se você tem muitos vegetais e sente que estão prestes a estragar, coloque todos no liquidificador e prepare um molho delicioso."

Dharath Hoonchamlong, cofundador de um bar com foco em sustentabilidade em Bangcoc, evita seguir "receitas rígidas" e prefere adaptar os pratos aos ingredientes que tem disponíveis.

Özkan conta que congela cascas de vegetais e depois as ferve em água. "Quando esfria, uso a água para regar minhas plantas e faço compostagem com as cascas restantes."

Frutas e vegetais podem ter várias partes aproveitadas no preparo de alimentos. — Foto: Tânia Rêgo / Agência Brasil

O Japão é o único país avaliado pelo Pnuma que conseguiu atingir a meta da ONU de reduzir pela metade o desperdício de alimentos nas residências e ao longo da cadeia de abastecimento, incluindo o setor empresarial, afirma O'Connor.

Ela atribui esse avanço a uma combinação de campanhas de conscientização pública, exigências de divulgação de dados por parte das empresas e colaboração entre os setores público e privado.

O Reino Unido também reduziu o desperdício de alimentos em 22% , em grande parte ao reunir empresas de diferentes etapas da cadeia de abastecimento alimentar para identificar onde ocorrem as perdas e trabalhar em conjunto para reduzi-las.

A iniciativa foi posteriormente adotada por países como África do Sul , Indonésia , México e Brasil . No entanto, apesar dos avanços em algumas áreas, o mundo está longe de atingir a meta global.

"Não há como conseguirmos reduzir pela metade o desperdício de alimentos até 2030", afirma Goodwin.

Ela diz que as empresas avançaram mais do que os governos, e que muitas grandes companhias do setor alimentício já estabeleceram metas e implementaram programas para reduzir o desperdício.

Contudo, avalia que os governos precisam fazer mais para incentivar as empresas a medir e divulgar seus índices de desperdício de alimentos. Isso, acredita, ajudaria a estimular a concorrência e promover melhorias.

Especialistas afirmam que combater o desperdício de alimentos exige ações em todo o sistema alimentar global, mas cada pessoa também pode fazer a diferença por meio de suas escolhas em casa.

"No fim das contas, depende de nós decidir se vamos jogar algo fora ou não", diz Goodwin.

*Com reportagem adicional de Pedro Martins, da BBC News Brasil

articles.title: Mercado financeiro prevê juros de dois dígitos até 2030, ao longo dos dois mandatos de Lula | G1
articles.standfirst: Expectativa consta de pesquisa realizada pelo BC com mais de 100 bancos. Quadro ocorre após déficits sucessivos nas contas públicas, a despeito da carga tributária recorde.
articles.summary: Expectativa consta de pesquisa realizada pelo BC com mais de 100 bancos. Quadro ocorre após déficits sucessivos nas contas públicas, a despeito da carga tributária recorde.
articles.body:
Mercado financeiro prevê juros de dois dígitos até 2030, ao longo dos dois mandatos de Lula — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

No início do terceiro mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, em 2023, o mercado financeiro projetava que a taxa básica de juros cairia para um dígito, abaixo de 10% ao ano, já em 2024.

Quase quatro anos depois, essa expectativa ficou mais distante. A previsão atual dos economistas dos bancos é de que a Selic não atingirá esse patamar nem em 2030.

➡️Se a previsão se confirmar, Lula passará o terceiro e o quarto mandatos inteiros com juros em dois dígitos (acima de 10% ao ano).

A expectativa dos economistas do mercado financeiro foi captada por meio de pesquisa realizada pelo Banco Central (BC) com mais de 100 instituições financeiras na semana passada.

Atualmente, a taxa está em 13,75% ao ano, o mesmo patamar do início de 2023. Em termos reais – ou seja, após o abatimento da inflação prevista para os próximos 12 meses –, o juro brasileiro está em 9,49% ao ano. É o maior patamar do mundo.

Até maio deste ano, o mercado acreditava que a taxa terminaria 2030 em 9,75% ao ano, em um dígito.

A partir daquele mês, os analistas passaram a projetar uma taxa de 10% ao ano.

A deterioração das expectativas do mercado nos últimos anos acontece após déficits sucessivos nas contas públicas .

A principal crítica é que as contas públicas continuaram no vermelho no terceiro mandato de Lula, mesmo com aumento de impostos e carga tributária recorde.

Durante o atual governo, a equipe econômica flexibilizou as metas das contas do governo , ampliando o espaço para despesas, fez uso do intervalo de tolerância previsto nas regras para as contas públicas e recorreu a receitas extraordinárias para cumprir os compromissos . Com autorização do Congresso, também realizou despesas por fora do limite estabelecido pela regra fiscal.

▶️O desempenho da atual gestão fiscal resultou em pressões inflacionárias, aumento dos juros e do endividamento público, em um processo de retroalimentação conhecido por economistas como "ciclo vicioso". Com a dívida em 82,9% do PIB pelo critério do BC e em 95,2% do PIB pelos cálculos do FMI, o Brasil registra um endividamento bem superior à média dos países emergentes.

De acordo com Jeferson Bittencourt, head de macroeconomia do ASA e ex-secretário do Tesouro Nacional, a piora na expectativa do mercado do terceiro para o quarto mandato é a "ausência do benefício da dúvida", ou seja, há uma descrença maior de que Lula vá promover um ajuste fiscal suficiente para estabilizar a dívida.

"No terceiro [mandato] se sabia que o novo governo trabalharia para revogar o teto de gastos, mas havia a dúvida sobre qual regra seria colocada no lugar. Para o quarto mandato, o novo arcabouço fiscal já é conhecido. Sabe-se que, quando cumprida à risca, ele oferece uma velocidade muito lenta de ajuste; que tanto o limite de despesas como a meta de superávit primário têm uma série de exceções; e que ante qualquer necessidade mais significativa novas exceções são adotadas, mesmo a regra tendo uma banda para acomodar choques", disse Bittencourt.

Solange Srour, diretora de macroeconomia para Brasil da gestora UBS GWM , disse que, diante do aumento dos juros nos Estados Unidos (que estabelece um piso maior para a taxa brasileira), considera díficil que a Selic volte a ficar abaixo de 10% ao ano nas condições atuais.

"O ambiente externo é apenas parte da explicação. No Brasil, a percepção mudou sobretudo porque aumentaram as dúvidas sobre a sustentabilidade da dívida pública. Com dívida elevada, despesas obrigatórias crescendo de forma estrutural e juros reais altos, cumprir metas fiscais de curto prazo não é suficiente se essas metas não estabilizam a relação dívida/PIB. O prêmio fiscal acaba aparecendo nos juros longos, no câmbio e nas expectativas de inflação e limita o espaço para uma queda mais rápida da Selic", diz a economista.

🔎A taxa de juros é definida pelo Banco Central com base no sistema de metas de inflação. O BC fixa a Selic olhando para frente, tendo por base as estimativas para o comportamento dos preços nos próximos anos.

Se as projeções estão em linha com as metas, pode manter ou baixar os juros. Se estão acima, a saída é elevar a taxa básica.

➡️A autoridade monetária esclarece, em sua página na internet , que a taxa básica da economia, a Selic, é de curto prazo.

Analistas observam que as taxas de juros negociadas no mercado para prazos mais longos (que servem de base para a venda de títulos públicos) reflete as expectativas dos agentes econômicos para gastos públicos e atividade, entre outros, e, consequentemente, para a inflação.

💰Juros altos têm consequências na economia e nas contas públicas. Eles tendem a frear o crédito, que fica mais caro, o consumo, o ritmo de atividade e o crescimento do emprego. Ao mesmo tempo, elevam as despesas com juros do setor público e pressionam o endividamento.

Trajetória da Selic, a taxa básica de juros, após decisão de novembro de 2026 — Foto: Arte/g1

▶️Para romper a atual dinâmica de pressão sobre a inflação e sobre endividamento público, possibilitando corte da Selic e da curva no mercado futuro, economistas e organismos financeiros internacionais avaliam que é preciso uma melhora das contas públicas — que registram déficits sucessivos há anos.

▶️O mercado financeiro é crítico da estratégia do governo federal do terceiro mandato de Lula de aumentar impostos para tentar reequilibrar as contas públicas, ao mesmo tempo que eleva gastos . Analistas pedem ênfase maior em cortes de despesas para que os juros possam recuar de forma sustentável no país, e conter a dívida pública.

"O ponto central é atacar os mecanismos que fazem a despesa obrigatória crescer automaticamente, em especial as regras de indexação e vinculação. Isso inclui rever a indexação de benefícios previdenciários e assistenciais ao salário mínimo, substituindo-a por uma referência compatível com a preservação do poder de compra, além de rever outras vinculações que fazem o gasto crescer de forma independente da situação fiscal", afirma Srour.

Ela defendeu, ainda, a revisão de benefícios fiscais "sem preservar exceções apenas porque determinados benefícios já existem há muito tempo ou têm grupos organizados em sua defesa".

Segundo Srour, também é preciso redesenhar e "melhorar a focalização" dos programas sociais, além de rever o MEI, o Simples Nacional e demais regimes especiais — preservando a formalização e a simplificação, mas reduzindo subsídios mal calibrados, distorções e tratamentos favorecidos sem justificativa econômica.

Economistas defendem o redesenho de programas como o MEI e o Simples Nacional — Foto: Divulgação/Sebrae

Para Bittencourt, melhorar a percepção do mercado financeiro passa pelo governo sinalizar maior disposição de sincronizar a política fiscal com a política monetária. Para isso, é necessário "mostrar compromisso com um ajuste nas contas que enderece a questão da sustentabilidade da dívida, retirando assim prêmio de risco da curva de juros".

Ele avaliou, ainda, que o pacote fiscal apresentado nesta semana ao Congresso Nacional inclui uma parte de ajuste permanente mais significativa, mas que não é uma mudança em relação à estratégia adotada até agora. Na prática, o foco permanece no aumento de receita, com um ajuste "bem menos significativo" pelo lado da despesa, acabando em 2030.

"Dado que a ajuda significativa para a melhora do primário não é uma mudança de estratégia, e a novidade no lado da despesa não traz contribuições significativas neste momento, não vejo o mercado mudando significativamente a visão sobre a taxa de juros ao longo do mandato", concluiu Bittencourt, do ASA.

Solange Srour concorda que o pacote não muda a trajetória fiscal, que é o que define os juros de curto e médio prazo . Segundo ela, o "mercado olha para a frente e enxerga uma dívida que continua crescendo rapidamente, sem âncora crível".

"A PEC que promete lidar de alguma forma com gastos obrigatórios e com limites às despesas fora do teto ainda não foi apresentada e assim não consigo avaliar se trará um choque de credibilidade suficiente para trazer os juros de fato para patamares mais baixos. Isso só ocorreria, no meu entender, com mudanças estruturais no gasto obrigatório, não com medidas que aumentem receitas ou a base de gastos passível de contingenciamento", concluiu a economista.

articles.title: FAA Ground Stop: What to do if your flight was delayed or canceled on Friday
articles.summary: What to do if your flight was cancelled or delayed by the FAA's national ground stop on Friday
articles.body:
Some offers on this page are from advertisers who pay us, which may affect which products we write about, but not our recommendations. See our Advertiser Disclosure .

If you were traveling on Friday and your flight was canceled or delayed by the hours-long stoppage affecting all departing flights in the U.S., you may be able to recoup some money, including a full refund in some cases.

A good first step is to call your airline. Check the airline's website and app for information about your options. For instance, United Airlines and Delta, two of the nation's largest airlines, put up banners on their websites on Friday evening with links to pages with directions on how to rebook for free or cancel.

A government-ordered ground stop is extremely unusual, and it's possible airlines will have some leeway in their obligations under these circumstances. Again, contact your airline for information.

Travelers delayed by the national ground stop should:

Verify your flight status with your airline . Delays will filter through the system for days.

Monitor your airline's mobile app for updates . Gates, connecting flights, and departure times are likely to change.

Some airlines have temporarily canceled service . Make sure you know when your flight will be rescheduled.

Know refund options available to you . Federal rules entitle you to a full refund if your flight is canceled or significantly delayed.

Rebook your flight through your airline's app . Rather than waiting in a long line, try rebooking your flight through an app.

Document receipts . Save every expense related to the delay for possible travel insurance reimbursement.

Here are major airline customer service numbers:

Southwest: 1-800-I-FLY-SWA (1-800-435-9792)

Alaska: 1-800-ALASKAAIR (1-800-252-7522)

Under normal government rules, travelers are entitled to a refund if the airline canceled your flight, regardless of the reason, according to the Department of Transportation . You are also entitled to a refund if the airline delays a flight. You do not have to accept travel credits, vouchers, or other forms of compensation. The delay typically needs to be at least three hours for domestic trips and six hours for international itineraries.

If you do not want to travel due to the disruption, you should ask your airline for a refund to your original payment method. Your refund should come in a week if you paid with a credit card. It could take three weeks for other payment methods.

Airlines are not always obligated to offer lodging, food, or other assistance for every delay or cancellation.

Nearly 14,500 flights were grounded Friday after an order from the Federal Aviation Administration. The halt to air travel was apparently caused by a telecommunications outage caused by a software update to Air Route Traffic Control Centers, the Associated Press reported. Homeland Security and government officials said that there was no indication of "nefarious acts" related to the telecommunications outage.

The travel interruption ended shortly before 9 p.m. Eastern time Friday.

Flights have resumed, though a chain reaction of delays and cancellations is expected to filter through the national flight system.

The interruption was the third nationwide ground stop in history, following a 2023 system failure and the September 11 attacks.

articles.title: Nvidia spy scandal: What Jensen Huang told top executives about his relationship with Alice Huang
articles.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled some of the chipmaker's senior executives about his relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang.
articles.body: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled some of the chipmaker's senior executives about his relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang. He portrayed their interactions as routine business dealings, despite having an affair with her, according to two people familiar with the matter and internal correspondence reviewed by Reuters.Among the executives Huang communicated with were general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld. In two separate messages sent in October, Huang told them that his interactions with Alice Huang were part of standard business dealings with customers. He also described his engagement with her company, Megaspeed International, as routine in other communications, people told Reuters.Reuters reviewed several exchanges from October on the condition that the messages would not be quoted verbatim. The news agency is the first to report on the correspondence.The two people said Huang had addressed questions about his relationship with Alice Huang on two occasions, during the autumn of 2025 and again in October 2026, after press queries brought the matter to the attention of some Nvidia leaders. On both occasions, he described their interactions as appropriate. Reuters reviewed only the October messages and not the exchanges from 2025.Alice Huang, a former senior executive at Megaspeed International, an Nvidia customer, was under investigation by the US over suspicions that she may have been spying for China. Jensen Huang and Alice Huang share the same surname but are not related.Earlier questions about meetings with Alice HuangHuang's interactions with Alice Huang had come under scrutiny following a New York Times article published in October last year, which highlighted their public meetings. According to the two people, Huang subsequently discussed the possibility of taking legal action against the newspaper.The article had also prompted him to communicate with some Nvidia leaders in 2025 about his interactions with Alice Huang. However, he did not describe the relationship as an affair, the people said.Neither Huang nor Nvidia eventually sued the newspaper. A spokesperson for the New York Times said it had received no legal demand.It remains unclear when the relationship became intimate. Photographs posted online and verified by Reuters show the two together in the US, China and elsewhere, dating back to December 2023.Board orders independent probeOn November 10, Nvidia's independent board members announced that they had appointed Wall Street law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an independent investigation. The move followed reports by the New York Times and Wall Street Journal about Huang's relationships with Alice Huang and US authorities' suspicions that she was spying for China.Beijing has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. Reuters has not independently verified whether she was working on behalf of the Chinese government.In an interview with Bloomberg published on October 29, Jensen Huang said the US government had not informed him about its suspicions concerning Alice Huang.Huang exits Nvidia Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on Thursday. His departure marks a dramatic fall from the top of the chip industry, where he was a pioneer of technology central to the recent artificial intelligence boom.In a statement earlier this week, he apologised for being unfaithful to his wife and disappointing the company. However, he did not specifically name Alice Huang.The revelations also follow reports of other relationships. The New York Times reported earlier this week that Huang had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia employee. Reuters reported on Thursday that he had another intimate relationship with a different Nvidia employee.Nvidia's stock has fallen more than 30% from its October 6 closing high, wiping out more than $1.8 trillion from its market capitalisation, taking the figure below $4 trillion mark for the first time.Money habits form by age 7. Is your child learning the right ones? Join the TOI Money Masterclass.

articles.title: Mumbai office boy earning Rs 3,500 a month faces Rs 1.46 crore tax assessment; alleges ex-employer misused KYC documents to obtain second PAN, ITAT quashes demand over invalid service of notice
articles.summary: A man who says he worked as an office boy for Rs 3,500 a month found himself facing an income-tax assessment of nearly Rs 1.47 crore after the tax
articles.body: A man who says he worked as an office boy for Rs 3,500 a month found himself facing an income-tax assessment of nearly Rs 1.47 crore after the tax department linked him to a pharmaceutical business and transactions recorded in its bank account. His defence was that he had never run the business and that his former employer had allegedly misused his signatures and identity documents.The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Mumbai, did not decide whether those allegations were true. Instead, it examined a more fundamental question: had the Income Tax Department validly served the notice that allowed it to reopen his assessment in the first place?In its September 21, 2026, order, the tribunal ruled that the department had failed to establish valid service and quashed the reassessment. The additions made in the proceedings consequently could not survive.What the case is aboutThe Income Tax Department initiated reassessment proceedings against a man after receiving information about transactions associated with a pharma company, described in the information available to the tax authorities as the man’s proprietary concern.The bank account records showed debit entries of Rs 1,27,62,500 and credit entries of Rs 18,85,000. The Assessing Officer treated the debit amount as unexplained expenditure under Section 69C of the Income Tax Act and the credit amount as unexplained income under Section 68. The assessment was completed under Sections 144 and 147, and the AO pegged the man’s total income at Rs 1,46,57,500.The assessee disputed the department's case on several fronts. According to his submissions, he had worked as an office boy for an employer from September 2009 for approximately 18 months, earning Rs 3,500 a month. He said he had provided signatures and KYC documents believing they were required for employment and security purposes.He alleged that the employer had used those documents to obtain another PAN without his knowledge. The man maintained that he had neither operated the pharma company nor undertaken the transactions in question. These remained his allegations; the tribunal did not establish that his former employer had misused his documents.The immediate legal dispute concerned a notice issued under Section 148 on March 27, 2019, which the man said he had never received.Why ITAT ruled in favour of the ex-office boyThe tribunal examined the department's records and found that the notice sent to an address in Bandra East had remained unserved. The department subsequently relied on affixture, or pasting the notice on a premises in Bhiwandi.The problem was that the department had not established any connection between the man and the locked room where the notice was pasted. Its own records indicated that he did not reside at the Bhiwandi address.The tribunal observed: “Affixture on the door of any locked room, without establishing that it was the residence or business premises of the assessee, cannot constitute service upon him merely because a departmental officer had gone there and pasted a notice.”The department eventually obtained the man’s Vile Parle address and email details through enquiries from TransUnion CIBIL. A show-cause notice sent on November 22, 2019, reached him, and he responded five days later, disputing the PAN and denying knowledge of the company.The tribunal noted: “The final show-cause notice dated 22.11.2019 was thus the first communication which, on the basis of the material before us, is shown to have actually reached the assessee.”The man had raised objections before the assessment was completed. The tribunal held that his subsequent cooperation could not retrospectively cure the failure to serve the original notice. It stated: “Participation after raising a timely objection cannot retrospectively convert affixture at an unrelated premises into valid service.”The judges concluded that valid service of the notice was essential for the department to assume jurisdiction over the reassessment. Their order stated: “The assessment order passed under section 144 read with section 147 is, therefore, invalid and is hereby quashed.”The additions of Rs 1,27,62,500 and Rs 18,85,000 consequently fell with the reassessment. The appeal was allowed.The tribunal expressly left undecided the alleged misuse of the man’s PAN, signatures and KYC documents, as well as the genuineness of the underlying transactions, because the reassessment was invalid on the jurisdictional ground.Money habits form by age 7. articles.summary: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s exit from the chipmaking giant may cost him a whopping $108 million in stock awards!
articles.body: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s exit from the chipmaking giant may cost him a whopping $108 million in stock awards!While the amount sounds huge, it is only a tiny fraction of the massive fortune he has built over 33 years at the company. With an estimated net worth of $144.5 billion, the Nvidia co-founder is set to give up just 0.07% of his wealth following his exit.Huang’s departure comes at a time when Nvidia shares have taken a hit.The company’s market value fell below $4 trillion for the first time since 2025 following news of his resignation. However, despite the fall, Huang’s biggest source of wealth remains his existing shareholding, valued at around $135 billion.The $108 million he is set to lose comes from stock awards that have not yet vested. Under Nvidia’s equity compensation policy, executives forfeit their unvested restricted stock units (RSUs) when they leave the company.Huang held around 346,000 such units and was expected to receive about 310,000 shares under the company’s equity incentive plan, provided certain performance targets were met.Following his exit, he will forfeit these unvested awards.Jensen Huang has already slipped out of the top 10 of Forbes' richest people list, with his wealth declining by $2.8 billion, or 1.97%. According to Nvidia's annual report and proxy statement for fiscal year 2026, Huang received total compensation of $36,343,830 during the year, down from $49.87 million in the previous financial year.His compensation package included a base salary of around $1.5 million, stock awards worth approximately $24.8 million and $6 million in non-equity incentive plan compensation. The remaining amount was classified as other compensation.(function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})();Where does Huang's $144.5 billion fortune come from?Almost all of Huang's wealth is tied to Nvidia shares. Unlike several other technology leaders, he has built his fortune mainly through owning the company's stock rather than stock options or other executive benefits.He owns around 812 million Nvidia shares, worth approximately $135 billion at Thursday's closing price. This makes him the company's largest individual shareholder. His holding represents less than 5% of Nvidia, while his voting stake stands at around 3.5%.According to Bloomberg's wealth index, Nvidia shares account for nearly 97% of his total fortune.His holdings are spread across shares owned directly by him, family trusts and holding companies. His charitable foundation separately holds around 59 million Nvidia shares, valued at more than $9 billion at current prices.Despite his substantial holding, Huang does not have special voting rights because Nvidia has only one class of shares.His salary and other cash payments form only a small part of his wealth. He received around $7.5 million in cash compensation in each of the past two years.Huang has already pocketed $3 billionAlthough Huang has held on to most of his Nvidia shares, he has sold around $3 billion worth of stock since the company went public in 1999, according to Capital IQ data and company filings.For most of his time as chief executive, his annual share sales remained relatively small, rarely crossing a few hundred million dollars. That changed as Nvidia's valuation climbed during the AI boom.Huang sold around $713 million worth of shares in 2024, followed by approximately $1 billion in 2025. These sales were made through pre-arranged trading plans as Nvidia's market value crossed $3 trillion and later $5 trillion.He has not sold any shares so far this year, according to the data.Can Huang turn his shares into cashWith Huang no longer leading Nvidia, attention is also turning to whether he will begin selling more of his shares. However, offloading such a large holding may not be easy.His share transactions could be affected by potential lengthy legal investigations into his relationship with a Chinese executive at a major Nvidia customer. Analysts at William Blair have described the matter as a “significant overhang on Nvidia shares in the near term”.There are also restrictions on when he can trade because of information he may have received while heading the company.Jesse Fried, a corporate governance expert at Harvard, said Huang would have to wait until material negative information that could affect Nvidia's share price became public before selling.“Huang can start selling as soon as any negative material non-public information he learned while CEO is disclosed,” Fried said.He is “OK to sell knowing undisclosed positive information, because [he] can’t profit from that,” Fried said.Nvidia's results next Tuesday could clear the way for Huang to start selling, provided he does not hold any other insider information, lawyers said.The size of his holding is another challenge. His 812 million shares are equivalent to around six days of Nvidia's total trading volume. Selling a large number of shares at once could put pressure on the stock price, meaning any sale would probably have to be spread over several months.Huang has also avoided borrowing against his Nvidia shares. Unlike some other technology billionaires, he has not pledged his stock as collateral for loans, as Nvidia does not allow its executives to do so.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Southeast Asian leaders to meet as Trump visit highlights trade disruption
articles.summary: ASEAN summit comes as US president embarks on Asia trip that will see him meet China’s Xi.
articles.body:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia – Southeast Asian leaders are preparing to hold their flagship annual summit as US President Donald Trump embarks on an Asia Pacific trip that will focus attention on his upending of trade and traditional alliances.

Leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) are gathering in Manila, the Philippines, for a series of multilateral and bilateral meetings running from Sunday until Tuesday.

Trump is scheduled to meet Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr during a brief stop in Manila on Tuesday, before heading to the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, where he will have his fourth face-to-face meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in just over a year.

It will also be the first time that Trump, Xi and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin will meet for trilateral talks, the White House has confirmed .

Trump’s visit to Southeast Asia – his second since his return to the White House after his attendance at the 2025 ASEAN summit in Malaysia – comes after his administration announced new tariffs on dozens of trade partners, including most of the region’s economies, in July.

Trump’s administration announced the duties of between 10 and 12.5 percent after the US Supreme Court struck down his steeper “reciprocal” tariffs in February.

The Office of the US Trade Representative said it was imposing the tariffs on 60 trade partners over their alleged failure to clamp down on forced labour.

The Trump administration is also conducting trade probes over alleged national security and “excess” manufacturing concerns that could result in yet more tariffs for Southeast Asian trade partners.

Southeast Asia has weathered Trump’s trade salvoes relatively unscathed until now, in part as a result of the diversion of billions of dollars of Chinese trade through the region.

US imports from ASEAN rose more than 29 percent to $453.6bn in 2025, expanding the trade deficit between the sides to $327.4bn, according to the Office of the US Trade Representative.

Deborah Elms, head of trade policy at the Hinrich Foundation in Singapore, said, however, that Southeast Asian countries cannot guarantee that their luck will continue.

“ASEAN has had mixed success in navigating US tariffs. Overall exports are up. But this is primarily driven by shipments of electronics which are largely exempt from tariffs,” Elms told Al Jazeera.

“These shipments are also strongly tied to the AI buildout. If that falters, ASEAN will feel it,” she said.

While ASEAN leaders have provided few details about the summit agenda, trade is likely to be among the main topics of discussion.

For a bloc that often faces accusations of being a talking shop, one of the most anticipated tangible outcomes is the signing of the Digital Economy Framework Agreement, a pact aimed at easing cross-border data transfers and electronic payments.

Initiated in 2023, the framework has been billed as a step towards building an ASEAN digital economy worth $2 trillion by 2030.

Jayant Menon, a senior fellow at the ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute in Singapore, said Southeast Asian leaders will be concerned about “what comes next” from Trump on trade.

“So far, the recent tariffs appear to have had a limited impact on competitiveness of ASEAN exports. But this may change in the future, with more sectoral tariffs, in particular, or other measures such as export controls,” Menon told Al Jazeera.

“Trump still retains significant autonomous authority over trade policy despite losing control of both houses, and could double down rather than back off,” Menon said, referring to the Republicans’ crushing defeat in the US midterm elections on November 3.

Phar Kim Beng, a professor of ASEAN studies at the International Islamic University of Malaysia, said Southeast Asian leaders are likely to reiterate calls for increased trade within the region, a goal that has lagged aspirations despite decades of trade liberalisation in the bloc.

“Whether measured from 1970 or 2025, intraregional trade remains paltry at 23 percent. In contrast, the European Union can cross intraregional trade of 67 percent easily,” Phar told Al Jazeera.

Phar said he does not expect ASEAN to announce any significant measures to spur trade within the bloc, but its leaders will continue to “mouth the mantra of better and bigger” trade volumes.

“Regardless of the tariffs intended by President Donald Trump, ASEAN will continue to muddle through by speaking of the importance of trade and more trade,” he said.

articles.body: The US dollar was heading for its biggest weekly gain in two months on Friday, staying close to a 19-month high as traders increased their bets on a larger interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve next month. The yen, meanwhile, remained close to the 160-per-dollar mark, keeping the possibility of Japanese government intervention in focus.Stronger-than-expected US inflation data this week and comments from Federal Reserve officials have led traders to expect a bigger-than-usual rate hike next month.This has also pushed up US treasury yields. Two-year Treasury yields have risen around 32 basis points this week to nearly 4.84%, putting them on track for their biggest weekly rise since April 2025.According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders are pricing in a roughly 92% chance of a 25-basis-point rate hike next month."The dollar is still firm and that's driven by a robust jobs report and an acceleration of the CPI," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex. "We've had a series of hawkish comments from Fed officials this week including from (New York Fed President John) Williams and (Fed Governor Christopher) Waller."The dollar index, which measures the US currency against a basket of currencies, rose 0.1% to 103.34. It remained close to its highest level since April 2025 and was heading for its biggest weekly rise since September. This would be its third consecutive week of gains.The euro fell 0.23% to $1.103 after touching its lowest level against the dollar since April 2025. It was also set for a fourth straight week of losses.The dollar gained 0.28% against the Swiss franc to 0.837, putting it on track to end two consecutive weeks of losses.Meanwhile, Japanese yen remained weak at 159.84 per dollar on Friday, close to its lowest level since early September. It has fallen around 1% this week and is heading for its biggest weekly decline since September.The yen's fall has raised concerns about possible intervention by Japanese authorities. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the government would respond appropriately to currency volatility.Elsewhere, the Australian dollar fell 0.46% to $0.678. It has been the worst-performing G10 currency against the dollar so far this month. Australia is also the only G10 country where markets expect an interest rate cut next year.The New Zealand dollar slipped 0.29% against the greenback to $0.553 and was heading for its third consecutive week of losses.Cryptocurrencies also recorded losses. articles.summary: Reservation Against Cancellation or RAC is an often talked about class of tickets that allows you an assured berth on a train, but on a sharing basis.
articles.body: Reservation Against Cancellation or RAC is an often talked about class of tickets that allows you an assured berth on a train, but on a sharing basis. Now, Indian Railways is examining whether it should discontinue the RAC facility.According to this TOI report, the proposal is being considered amid concerns about passenger comfort and whether a reservation arrangement that has existed for decades needs to be reconsidered.“There is a view that when a passenger isn’t getting full sleeping space, it may not be appropriate to charge the full fare,” said an official.Let’s first understand what is Reservation Against Cancellation ticket:What is RAC and what are the rules for booking, berth allocation, cancellation and refunds?RAC is a train ticket under which two passengers share a single berth even though each is charged the full fare and receives only half the sleeping space.RAC originated at a time when railway reservations were largely processed manually and there was no electronic mechanism to track cancellations and vacant berths in real time.Under the system, two passengers could be accommodated on one berth, with the possibility of one of them being allotted a full berth if the other passenger cancelled the ticket.RAC bookings can also lead to uncomfortable situations when a male and a female passenger are allotted the same seat.Ticket examiners often find it difficult to arrange alternative accommodation in such cases.Basically RAC allows passengers to travel in a reserved coach with confirmed sitting accommodation. However, Indian Railways' reservation rules do not guarantee them a full berth for sleeping.RAC passengers may be allotted full berths that become available because of cancellations or passengers not turning up before the train departs.When cancellations create vacancies, these berths can be allotted to RAC passengers before waitlisted travellers are given confirmed accommodation.Berths that fall vacant during the journey may also be assigned to RAC passengers under the applicable railway rules. If no full berth is available, passengers must continue their journey using the reserved sitting accommodation that is allotted to them.RAC status does not guarantee every passenger a separate sleeping berth. Nor does it mean that all RAC passengers must necessarily share a side-lower berth in every situation.The accommodation provided depends on the reservation and berth-allotment arrangements applicable to the particular train and class of travel.The rules governing cancellations and refunds are determined by the applicable railway refund provisions. The amount refunded and the charges deducted depend, among other factors, on the status of the ticket when the cancellation is made.The key distinction is that RAC permits passengers to travel with reserved sitting accommodation, while a full berth is allotted only if one becomes available.RAC tickets can be cancelled or refund applied online up to half an hour before the scheduled departure of the train. In case of cancellation of the train, the refund is automatically issued.The practice of collecting the full fare from passengers travelling on RAC tickets has also come under scrutiny from a parliamentary panel, which questioned the justification for the arrangement.The panel has urged Indian Railways to review the existing system so that passengers are not charged the entire fare without receiving the benefit of a full berth.Basically RAC allows passengers to travel in a reserved coach with confirmed sitting accommodation. articles.title: TRAI's spam crackdown: Regularity authority bars 1.24 lakh telecom resources, blacklists 374 entities over violations
articles.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) barred more than 1.24 lakh telecom resources from outgoing services and blacklisted 374 entities for one
articles.body: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) barred more than 1.24 lakh telecom resources from outgoing services and blacklisted 374 entities for one year for violating unsolicited commercial communication (UCC) rules during July-September, as the regulator intensified action against spam calls and messages.According to TRAI's quarterly report for the second quarter of 2026-27, 1,10,325 telecom resources, including mobile numbers, were barred from outgoing services for 15 days for a first violation. Another 13,777 resources were disconnected for one year after repeat violations.The regulator also blocked 3,725 SMS headers and blacklisted 374 senders for a year. During this period, the blacklisted entities cannot obtain fresh telecom resources.TRAI receives 15.29 lakh spam complaintsTRAI received 15.29 lakh complaints about unsolicited commercial communications during the quarter, of which 7.23 lakh were classified as actionable.The complaints came against the backdrop of 714.01 billion calls and 702.28 billion SMSes originating from telecom networks across the country. The complaint rate stood at around 2.14 per million outgoing calls, the report said.The TRAI DND App remained the main channel for reporting spam, accounting for 14.21 lakh complaints, or 92.9% of the total. The application had recorded 42.36 lakh downloads by September 30.Telecom operators' artificial intelligence-based systems flagged 19.9 billion incoming calls and SMSes as suspected spam during the quarter. These included 18.28 billion calls and 1.62 billion SMSes.Operators also issued more than 45.9 lakh warning notifications to entities suspected of sending spam communications. They carried out electronic know-your-customer (e-KYC) verification of 34,025 suspected senders, while 9,977 were disconnected for failing the KYC verification process.Promotional and service calls assigned separate number seriesTRAI has introduced dedicated numbering series to help consumers distinguish promotional calls from service and transactional communications.Promotional calls are routed through the 140 series, while the 1600 series is meant for service and transactional calls from entities in banking, financial services and insurance, as well as government-to-citizen communications.A separate 1601 series was introduced on August 10 for service and transactional calls from utilities, logistics and delivery companies.During the quarter, 15.27 billion promotional calls originated through the 140 series. Of these, 1.70 billion were blocked after verification against registered Do Not Disturb preferences.Registered telemarketers also originated 660.71 billion commercial SMSes, while 11.09 billion promotional messages were blocked following preference verification.Over 22 crore consumers registered on DND registryThe report showed that 22.449 crore consumers had registered their communication preferences on the DND registry as of September 30. This represented 16.64% of the country's 134.9-crore subscriber base.More than 112 crore subscribers had not registered any preferences and remained accessible to commercial communications from registered senders and telemarketers.TRAI said its consumer awareness initiatives during the quarter included campaigns across radio, television, newspapers and social media.
